craft_notes: Sthāyin: FIRST DHĀRAÑĀ (v24 = dhāraṇā 1). Sanskrit: ūrdhve prāṇo hy adho jīvo...bharaṇād bharitā sthitiḥ → L4 keeps the three breaths named and standing as result. Rows: row 3 (above/below/emission triad). Close: standing (posture noun — sthiti). Minimal pass: none. Read aloud: above—below—emission: STANDING. Rejected: 'apāna-prāṇa' technical labels — killed: life/breath/emission plain; 'jugular' — killed: nothing anatomical beyond text.

lines: Breath above, life below, the emission-natured —
uttering forth: at two arising places, filled, standing.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ūrdhve prāṇo hy adho jīvo visargātmā paroccaret | utpattidvitayasthāne bharaṇād bharitā sthitiḥ

reads_against.argmap: Where does breath rest? → Breath meeting-point standing: filling at the two arising places completes the posture.
c1_essence: Breath above, life below: filling at two arising places.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra undertow (stillness carrying resolve)
